screen.grandline.abilities.hint: Pick an ability, then click a slot. Right-click a slot to clear it.
screen.grandline.abilities.none: You have no abilities yet. Eat a Devil Fruit, train Haki or learn a fighting style. Creators can use /onepiece unlock all.
ability.grandline.soru.desc: Kick the ground dozens of times in an instant and vanish. Blink up to 8 blocks forward; attacks miss you for a moment.
ability.grandline.geppo.desc: Kick the air itself to jump again in mid-air. Up to 3 kicks before you must land. Cancels fall damage.
ability.grandline.tekkai.desc: Hold to harden your body like iron. Physical damage is cut to a quarter and knockback ignored, but you can barely move.
fruit.grandline.gum_gum.desc: Turns the body into rubber. Stretch to strike from afar, slingshot across the map, shrug off blunt blows and lightning, bounce off any fall. Awakens into Gear Fifth.
fruit.grandline.leopard.desc: A carnivorous Zoan. Become a towering leopard-man or a full leopard: claws that make wounds bleed, pounces, and a predator's speed. Awakens into a berserk hunter.
fruit.grandline.flame.desc: A Logia: your body is fire. Blows pass through you, fire cannot hurt you, and your flames burn everything they touch. Awakens to set the battlefield itself alight.
ability.grandline.fire_fist.desc: Hold to gather fire into your fist, release to hurl it as a huge burning projectile. A full charge is bigger and hits harder.
ability.grandline.fire_gun.desc: Finger guns: five fast fire bullets in a tight spread.
ability.grandline.flame_commandment.desc: Raise a wall of fire in front of you. It burns and pushes back anyone crossing it and burns arrows out of the air.
ability.grandline.fire_pillar.desc: Mark a spot; a moment later a column of fire erupts there, launching and burning everyone on it.
ability.grandline.flame_emperor.desc: Gather a small sun over your head while you stand still, then hurl it. Slow, costly and devastating.
ability.grandline.fireflies.desc: Awakened. Scatter glowing fireflies that drift to nearby enemies and cling to them.
ability.grandline.firefly_detonate.desc: Awakened. Ignite every firefly you placed; each bursts into a fire explosion.
ability.grandline.flame_field.desc: Awakened. The ground around you becomes a sea of flames, burning and slowing enemies while it lasts.
ability.grandline.gum_pistol.desc: A stretching punch that reaches 14 blocks. In Gear Second it becomes the faster Jet Pistol.
ability.grandline.gum_rocket.desc: Grab a far block with both arms and slingshot yourself to it.
ability.grandline.gum_gatling.desc: Hold for a storm of stretching punches in front of you.
ability.grandline.gum_bazooka.desc: Pull both arms back, release to slam both palms forward with huge knockback.
ability.grandline.gear_second.desc: Pump blood through your rubber veins: faster, stronger, steaming. Pistol becomes Jet Pistol.
ability.grandline.gum_giant_pistol.desc: Inflate your arm to giant size, then punch through everything in a line.
ability.grandline.gear_fifth.desc: Awakened. The rubber body becomes free: enemies near you bounce off the rubbery ground.
ability.grandline.gum_dawn_fist.desc: Awakened, Gear Fifth only. A fist the size of a house drops from the sky onto the target.
ability.grandline.leopard_hybrid.desc: Become a leopard-man: bigger, armoured, clawed and stronger.
ability.grandline.leopard_beast.desc: Become a full leopard: very fast, low to the ground, fits through one-block gaps.
ability.grandline.leopard_pounce.desc: Leap at your prey; the first enemy you hit is mauled and slowed. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.leopard_claws.desc: Three raking slashes in front of you that leave bleeding wounds. Needs a form.
ability.grandline.leopard_frenzy.desc: Hold to become a whirlwind of claws. Hybrid form only.
ability.grandline.leopard_primal_fury.de: Awakened. Berserk: rapid regeneration, toughness and strength while transformed.
ability.grandline.leopard_roar.desc: Awakened. A roar that knocks back and weakens everyone nearby.
ability.grandline.observation_haki.desc: Sense every living presence nearby, even through walls; enemies glow red. While active you may read and dodge attacks (12-40% chance by level, costs stamina).
ability.grandline.future_sight.desc: See a few seconds ahead: every attack aimed at you is dodged for a small stamina cost, and you see where enemies are about to move. Observation level 60.
ability.grandline.armament_haki.desc: Coat your arms in black Haki. Blows hit 25-50% harder and strike a Logia's true body.
ability.grandline.full_body_hardening.de: Harden your whole body: damage taken is cut by 30-45%, knockback mostly ignored, and every blow counts as Armament. Armament level 35.
ability.grandline.armament_emission.desc: Your next blow within 5 seconds sends Haki through the target, ignoring armour and blasting it back from inside. Needs an active coating. Armament level 70.
ability.grandline.conquerors_haki.desc: Hold to gather your will, release to unleash it. Weak-willed foes collapse, others are intimidated, and another king clashes with you. Charge longer for a wider wave.
ability.grandline.conquerors_infusion.de: Wrap your attacks in Conqueror's Haki: black lightning on every blow, much harder hits that hurl foes back and touch a Logia. Conqueror's level 60.
death.attack.grandline.dark: %1$s was swallowed by the darkness of %2$s
death.attack.grandline.dark.player: %1$s was swallowed by the darkness of %2$s
fruit.grandline.smoke.desc: Become smoke: drift, bind foes in white clouds and slip through every blow.
fruit.grandline.sand.desc: Become sand: desert blades, sandstorms and a touch that dries everything it grips.
fruit.grandline.rumble.desc: Become lightning: strike from the sky and move at the speed of thunder.
fruit.grandline.ice.desc: Become ice: freeze the ground, the sea and anyone you touch.
fruit.grandline.dark.desc: Command darkness: pull everything in, swallow attacks and nullify Devil Fruit powers.
fruit.grandline.glint.desc: Become light: kicks at light speed, rains of laser and instant travel.
fruit.grandline.magma.desc: Become magma: fists of molten rock that burn even fire.
fruit.grandline.swamp.desc: Become a bottomless swamp that swallows enemies and stores anything.
fruit.grandline.gas.desc: Become gas: poison clouds, explosive mixtures and air with no oxygen.
fruit.grandline.snow.desc: Become snow: blizzards, snow rabbits and a body that buries foes.
fruit.grandline.forest.desc: Become a forest: roots that drain life, vines that bind and trees that grow at will.
fruit.grandline.op.desc: Create a ROOM where you rearrange, slice and swap anything inside like a surgeon.
fruit.grandline.tremor.desc: Shake the very air and earth: quakes that crack the sky and topple islands.
fruit.grandline.string.desc: Make razor strings: slice, puppet foes, walk the clouds and cage a whole island.
fruit.grandline.mochi.desc: A special Paramecia: create, become and shape sticky mochi.
fruit.grandline.chop.desc: Split your body into floating pieces; blades cannot cut you.
fruit.grandline.slip.desc: A perfectly smooth body: attacks slide off and you slide anywhere.
fruit.grandline.bomb.desc: Make any part of your body (even your breath and snot) explode.
fruit.grandline.kilo.desc: Change your weight from one kilo to ten thousand: float, then crush.
fruit.grandline.flower.desc: Sprout copies of your limbs anywhere you can see: grab, clutch and build giant hands.
fruit.grandline.wax.desc: Make wax as hard as steel: armour, shackles and weapons.
fruit.grandline.munch.desc: Eat anything and become what you ate.
fruit.grandline.clone.desc: Take the face and body of anyone you have touched.
fruit.grandline.dice.desc: Turn your body into steel blades.
fruit.grandline.spike.desc: Grow spikes from anywhere on your body.
fruit.grandline.bind.desc: Anything that passes through your body is locked in iron bonds.
fruit.grandline.spring.desc: Turn your legs and arms into springs: rebound jumps and spring-loaded blows.
fruit.grandline.slow.desc: Fire Noro Noro beams that slow anything they touch for thirty seconds.
fruit.grandline.door.desc: Open doors in anything, even the air itself.
fruit.grandline.bubble.desc: Make soap bubbles that wash away strength and slipperiness.
fruit.grandline.berry.desc: Split into berry-like balls that scatter from any attack.
fruit.grandline.rust.desc: Rust any metal you touch until it crumbles.
fruit.grandline.wheel.desc: Turn your limbs into wheels and race along the ground.
fruit.grandline.revive.desc: Return to life once after death, with a soul that can leave the body and freeze foes.
fruit.grandline.shadow.desc: Control shadows: steal them, swap places with yours and send it to fight.
fruit.grandline.hollow.desc: Release ghosts: negative hollows drain the will to fight.
fruit.grandline.clear.desc: Become invisible, along with anything you touch.
fruit.grandline.paw.desc: Paw pads that repel anything: air, pain, fatigue, even people across the world.
fruit.grandline.love.desc: Turn anyone smitten by you to stone.
fruit.grandline.venom.desc: Make deadly poisons: venom hydras, poison clouds and a demon of venom.
fruit.grandline.hormone.desc: Inject hormones that heal, enrage, grow or change a body.
fruit.grandline.snip.desc: Turn your hands into scissors that cut anything like paper.
fruit.grandline.wash.desc: Wash people clean of evil and wring them dry like laundry.
fruit.grandline.float.desc: Make anything you have touched float, yourself included.
fruit.grandline.mark.desc: Mark a target: anything you throw will hunt it down.
fruit.grandline.arms.desc: Turn any part of your body into weapons: blades, guns, missiles.
fruit.grandline.spin.desc: Spin your limbs like propellers: fly and grind.
fruit.grandline.stick.desc: Secrete flammable mucus that glues anything in place.
fruit.grandline.ripple.desc: Make anything ripple like a flag: steel cloaks, flowing blades.
fruit.grandline.stone.desc: Merge with and command stone: walls, fists and a giant stone body.
fruit.grandline.stitch.desc: Sew anything together, even people to the ground.
fruit.grandline.glare.desc: See through everything and everyone, even into minds.
fruit.grandline.art.desc: Turn people and places into abstract art that cannot move properly.
fruit.grandline.jacket.desc: Become a jacket and take over whoever wears you.
fruit.grandline.pop.desc: Make your body and anything you touch swell and burst.
fruit.grandline.swim.desc: Swim through the ground and walls as if they were water.
fruit.grandline.hobby.desc: Turn anyone you touch into a toy bound to obey.
fruit.grandline.barrier.desc: Create unbreakable barriers: walls, stairs, crushing boxes.
fruit.grandline.calm.desc: Silence every sound around you or around what you touch.
fruit.grandline.heal.desc: Heal wounds with tears and spores of light.
fruit.grandline.biscuit.desc: Make hard biscuit soldiers and armour.
fruit.grandline.soul.desc: Take people's lifespan and give souls to objects: living suns, clouds and swords.
fruit.grandline.mirror.desc: Make mirrors that reflect attacks and open into the Mirro-World.
fruit.grandline.lick.desc: Make and shape hard candy: cages, spears, walls.
fruit.grandline.wring.desc: Wring anything dry and take its moisture to grow.
fruit.grandline.memory.desc: Pull out, edit and erase memories like film.
fruit.grandline.heat.desc: Heat your body hot enough to boil the sea.
fruit.grandline.castle.desc: Become a living fortress with soldiers inside and cannons outside.
fruit.grandline.clothes.desc: Make clothes out of anything and dress anyone in an instant.
fruit.grandline.time.desc: Leap forward through time, and send others with you.
fruit.grandline.ripe.desc: Ripen anything you touch until it rots.
fruit.grandline.millet.desc: Make millet dumplings that tame any beast that eats them.
fruit.grandline.gold.desc: Shape any gold you have touched into weapons, giants and prisons.
fruit.grandline.song.desc: Pull listeners into a world made of song.
fruit.grandline.warp.desc: Warp yourself and others to anywhere you can see.
fruit.grandline.magnet.desc: Magnetise and control metal: pull, repel and build an arm of scrap.
fruit.grandline.gravity.desc: Control gravity: crush, lift, and call meteors from space.
fruit.grandline.age.desc: Make anyone older or younger, yourself included, even into a possible future.
fruit.grandline.brain.desc: A brain that never stops growing: perfect recall and genius invention.
fruit.grandline.genie.desc: Summon a giant genie of smoke from your body.
fruit.grandline.straw.desc: Become straw: straw dolls take your wounds for you.
fruit.grandline.tone.desc: Turn your body into instruments; each note is an attack.
fruit.grandline.guzzle.desc: Turn the alcohol you drink into fire breath.
fruit.grandline.island.desc: Merge with the land itself: an island that fights for you.
fruit.grandline.push.desc: Push and knead the ground like clay.
fruit.grandline.return.desc: Send anything you touch back in time.
fruit.grandline.sprout.desc: Make plants grow explosively in an instant.
fruit.grandline.luck.desc: Steal the luck of anyone you touch.
fruit.grandline.human.desc: An animal that eats it gains a human form and a human mind.
fruit.grandline.falcon.desc: Become a great falcon and rule the skies.
fruit.grandline.jackal.desc: Become a jackal with fearsome jaws.
fruit.grandline.mole.desc: Become a mole and tunnel through the ground.
fruit.grandline.bison.desc: Become a charging bison with crushing horns.
fruit.grandline.wolf.desc: Become a wolf: speed, fangs and a hunter's nose.
fruit.grandline.giraffe.desc: Become a giraffe: a neck like a battering ram and legs like blades.
fruit.grandline.horse.desc: Become a horse, or a winged pegasus if a bird eats it.
fruit.grandline.anaconda.desc: Become an anaconda: constrict and crush.
fruit.grandline.king_cobra.desc: Become a king cobra: venom and a scorching hood.
fruit.grandline.axolotl.desc: Become an axolotl of living poison gas.
fruit.grandline.albatross.desc: Become an albatross and soar over the sea.
fruit.grandline.tanuki.desc: Become a tanuki and transform into objects.
fruit.grandline.elephant.desc: Become an elephant: tusks, trunk and earth-shaking stomps.
fruit.grandline.pteranodon.desc: Become a pteranodon: flight, speed and a crushing beak.
fruit.grandline.triceratops.desc: Become a triceratops with a spinning frill.
fruit.grandline.pachycephalosaurus.desc: Become a pachycephalosaurus with an iron skull.
fruit.grandline.spider.desc: Become an ancient spider: webs and burning silk.
fruit.grandline.phoenix.desc: Become a phoenix wreathed in blue flames that heal.
fruit.grandline.azure_dragon.desc: Become an azure dragon that rides the clouds and breathes fire.
fruit.grandline.yamata: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi
fruit.grandline.yamata.desc: Become an eight-headed serpent that lives as long as one head does.
item.grandline.yamata_fruit: Snake-Snake Fruit, Model: Yamata no Orochi
fruit.grandline.nine_tailed_fox.desc: Become a nine-tailed fox and take anyone's form.
fruit.grandline.okuchi_wolf: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami
fruit.grandline.okuchi_wolf.desc: Become a divine wolf guardian of ice.
item.grandline.okuchi_wolf_fruit: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami
fruit.grandline.buddha.desc: Become a giant golden Buddha whose palms send shockwaves.
fruit.grandline.bakotsu.desc: Become a skeletal horse whose blade freezes what it cuts.
fruit.grandline.sandworm.desc: Become an enormous sandworm that devours the land.
ability.grandline.black_hole.desc: Spread darkness under your feet that drags in and crushes everything around it.
ability.grandline.kurouzu.desc: A whirlpool of darkness from your hand yanks your target straight into your grip.
ability.grandline.dark_matter.desc: Throw a ball of compressed darkness: where it lands, a small black hole opens.
ability.grandline.liberation.desc: Release everything the darkness swallowed in one violent blast ahead of you.
ability.grandline.darkness_nullify.desc: Seize a foe: darkness smothers their Devil Fruit, leaving them powerless and solid.
ability.grandline.black_world.desc: Drown a whole area in darkness: everyone in it is blinded, dragged and crushed.
ability.grandline.abyss_gate.desc: Pull every creature around you into your hands and hold them there.
ability.grandline.root_snare.desc: Roots burst out of the ground where you point, binding the legs of everyone nearby.
ability.grandline.vine_lash.desc: A sweeping lash of thorned vines that cuts everyone in front of you and drags them in.
ability.grandline.nutrient_drain.desc: Hold to drink the life from every creature around you, healing as they wither. Rooted foes give twice as much.
ability.grandline.timber_wall.desc: Raise a wall of living timber in front of you.
ability.grandline.thorn_field.desc: Carpet the ground with thorns: anyone who walks through them is slowed and cut.
ability.grandline.great_forest.desc: Become a forest: a vast wildwood springs up around you that seizes and drains everyone in it.
ability.grandline.giant_tree.desc: A giant tree erupts where you point, hurling everyone standing there into the sky.
ability.grandline.gastanet.desc: A pocket of gas where you look, then a snap of your fingers: it explodes.
ability.grandline.shinokuni.desc: Release a spreading cloud of poison gas: anyone inside is poisoned and slowed.
ability.grandline.oxygen_theft.desc: Hold: take the oxygen from around your target. It chokes, reels and weakens while you keep it up.
ability.grandline.gas_rocket.desc: Ignite the gas beneath you and rocket away, leaving an explosion behind.
ability.grandline.gas_bombs.desc: Throw three canisters of gas that burst into small poison clouds.
ability.grandline.noxious_domain.desc: Become a poison storm: a huge cloud that follows you and poisons everyone in it.
ability.grandline.gamma_knife.desc: A beam of lethal radiation-laced gas that pierces everyone in a line, poisoning them deeply.
ability.grandline.yasakani_no_magatama.d: Hold to fire a stream of light bullets that burst where they land.
ability.grandline.ama_no_murakumo.desc: Form a sword of light and cut in a wide arc.
ability.grandline.light_speed_kick.desc: Arrive at your target at the speed of light with a kick that sends it flying.
ability.grandline.light_laser.desc: A laser from your fingertip that pierces everything in a long line.
ability.grandline.light_travel.desc: Become light and appear far ahead in an instant.
ability.grandline.amaterasu.desc: A flash as bright as the sun: everyone around is blinded, burned and left glowing.
ability.grandline.light_rain.desc: Lasers rain from the sky over an area for several seconds.
ability.grandline.ice_age.desc: Freeze everything in front of you: creatures are sealed in ice and the water turns solid.
ability.grandline.ice_saber.desc: Form a sword of ice and cut in a wide arc: deep cold slows whoever it touches.
ability.grandline.partisan.desc: A fan of ice spears that pierce everything and freeze it to the bone.
ability.grandline.pheasant_beak.desc: Charge a great bird of ice and send it diving: it bursts and freezes everything around the impact.
ability.grandline.ice_time.desc: Touch a foe and seal it in ice for a long time.
ability.grandline.ice_wall.desc: Raise a wall of solid ice in front of you.
ability.grandline.glacial_world.desc: The world around you freezes over: every enemy in a huge circle is sealed in ice.
ability.grandline.ice_time_capsule.desc: Seal a foe in a capsule of ice that holds for a long time and wounds as it forms.
ability.grandline.great_eruption.desc: Charge a fist of magma and launch it: it explodes and leaves the ground molten.
ability.grandline.hound_blaze.desc: Lunge forward as a hound of magma and bite down on whatever is in front of you.
ability.grandline.meteor_volcano.desc: Hurl magma into the sky: it comes down as a rain of molten fists around where you look.
ability.grandline.magma_pool.desc: Melt the ground around you into a pool of magma that burns anyone standing in it.
ability.grandline.volcanic_pillars.desc: Pillars of magma burst out of the ground in a line toward where you look.
ability.grandline.volcano_field.desc: The ground around you becomes a volcano: eruptions keep bursting at random for several seconds.
ability.grandline.magma_tsunami.desc: A wall of magma rolls forward, burning and sweeping away everything in its path.
ability.grandline.el_thor.desc: Gather lightning, then call down a pillar of it wherever you look.
ability.grandline.vari.desc: A million volts in every direction: everyone around you is struck and locked up for a moment.
ability.grandline.sango.desc: A bolt from your hand that jumps from the first foe it hits to the ones beside it.
ability.grandline.thunder_spear.desc: Hurl a spear of lightning that passes straight through everyone in its path.
ability.grandline.thunder_travel.desc: Travel as a bolt to where you look; landing discharges into anyone nearby.
ability.grandline.raigo.desc: Summon a thunder cloud over an area: bolts keep falling on anyone beneath it.
ability.grandline.mamaragan.desc: Lightning falls on every enemy for a great distance around you at once.
ability.grandline.desert_spada.desc: A blade of sand races along the ground, splitting it and cutting everyone in its path.
ability.grandline.sables.desc: Send a sandstorm rolling forward that pulls in, blinds and grinds down everything it passes.
ability.grandline.ground_secco.desc: Grip a foe and drink the water from their body: heavy damage, weakness and thirst. You recover a little.
ability.grandline.desert_girasole.desc: Turn the ground ahead into quicksand that holds and slowly swallows anyone caught in it.
ability.grandline.sand_shift.desc: Scatter into sand and reform further ahead.
ability.grandline.desert_encierro.desc: A pillar of sand closes around your target, holding it fast while it dries out.
ability.grandline.great_sandstorm.desc: Become the eye of a great sandstorm that blinds, starves and grinds everyone around you.
ability.grandline.white_blow.desc: A fist of smoke that seizes whoever it hits and drags them back to you.
ability.grandline.white_snake.desc: Three serpents of smoke hunt the nearest enemies and coil around their legs.
ability.grandline.white_launcher.desc: Turn into a jet of smoke and blast forward, bowling over anything in the way.
ability.grandline.white_out.desc: Flood the area with smoke: enemies inside are blinded and slowed, and you vanish within it.
ability.grandline.smoke_ride.desc: Become a drifting cloud and fly. Drains stamina while airborne.
ability.grandline.white_prison.desc: Smoke engulfs a whole area and hardens around everyone in it.
ability.grandline.white_vortex.desc: Hold to become a cyclone of smoke that drags everything nearby into you.
ability.grandline.kamakura.desc: Raise a dome of packed snow around yourself: a shelter, or a trap for whoever is inside with you.
ability.grandline.snow_rabbits.desc: Four rabbits of snow bound off after the nearest enemies, freezing whoever they reach.
ability.grandline.blizzard.desc: Hold to blast a freezing blizzard ahead of you that pushes enemies back.
ability.grandline.snowfield.desc: Blanket the ground in snow: enemies wade through it slowly while it speeds you up.
ability.grandline.snow_burial.desc: Bury your target in a mound of snow that holds it fast.
ability.grandline.white_land.desc: Turn the land around you into a frozen white waste that slows and freezes everyone in it.
ability.grandline.avalanche.desc: Send an avalanche rolling forward that buries and sweeps away everyone in its path.
ability.grandline.swamp_pit.desc: Turn the ground where you look into a bottomless swamp: anyone in it sinks and cannot get out.
ability.grandline.swamp_swallow.desc: The swamp in your body opens up and swallows a nearby foe whole, then holds it.
ability.grandline.mud_shot.desc: Hold to spray a stream of heavy mud that bogs down whoever it hits.
ability.grandline.bottomless_body.desc: Let your body turn to swamp: arrows and other projectiles sink into you harmlessly (and are kept).
ability.grandline.swamp_spew.desc: Spit out everything the swamp swallowed in a crushing torrent. More stored, more damage.
ability.grandline.endless_swamp.desc: The whole area around you becomes swamp.
ability.grandline.swamp_grave.desc: Everyone around you is dragged under the mud and held there.
